description: This source file contains functions related to Broadcom wireless device management in OpenWrt. It includes functions for scanning, enabling, disabling, and detecting Broadcom wireless interfaces, as well as configuring wireless settings and network integration.

methods.name: scan_broadcom
methods.description: Scans and configures wireless VIFs (Virtual Interfaces) for a given device, setting up modes such as adhoc, station, access point, monitor, and WDS, and configuring related parameters.

methods.name: disable_broadcom
methods.description: Shuts down the wireless device, cleans up network interfaces, and disables the driver.

methods.name: enable_broadcom
methods.description: Configures and enables a Broadcom wireless device with various parameters such as channel, country, max associations, VIFs, power, security, and modes.

methods.name: detect_broadcom
methods.description: Detects Broadcom wireless devices in the system and initializes their configuration via UCI commands.
